measurementSources.docOverflowX: DOM: document.documentElement.scrollWidth - document.documentElement.clientWidth at the emulated viewport (SG-183 denominator shape)
measurementSources.offenders: DOM: getBoundingClientRect of every body element; right > clientWidth+1 or left < -1; excessRight = right - clientWidth
measurementSources.targets: DOM: querySelectorAll('a[href], button, select, input, textarea, [role=button|link|tab]'), rect + computed display/font; inNavShell = inside <nav> or the AppHeader root div
measurementSources.targetDispositions: shared evalTargets (WCAG 2.5.8 shape of SG-183/190: undersized <24; circle-vs-rect edge<12; circle-vs-circle center<24; inline-in-text exception candidate)
measurementSources.contrast: DOM tree-walker text nodes: computed color over ancestor background chain (alpha composited; image backdrops flagged unknown), WCAG relative-luminance ratio
measurementSources.surfaces: DOM element-level samples (same color/bg chain math) for select/link/badge/alert surfaces that render text without a laid-out text node (closed <select>)
measurementSources.density: DOM computed styles: display:grid elements (computed gridTemplateColumns track count, gaps, visible children, child rects) and <table> elements (row count, first-row cells/height, scrollWidth vs parent clientWidth)
measurementSources.tap: CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent touchStart+touchEnd at the element center; element hit via document.elementFromPoint; focus via document.activeElement; navigation via location.pathname before/after
measurementSources.menuState: DOM: #sg-nav-menu data-open attribute, computed display; .nav-menu-toggle computed display
measurementSources.darkMechanism: localStorage sg-theme seeded pre-load via Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument (runs before any document script; index.html inline script and ThemeProvider.tsx both read it); html.dark class verified in-page
measurementSources.touchEmulation: Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride mobile:true + Emulation.setTouchEmulationEnabled(maxTouchPoints=5); verified via navigator.maxTouchPoints and 'ontouchstart' in window
measurementSources.zoomEmulation: 200% browser zoom emulated as CSS viewport halved at DPR 2 (1280x900 -> 640x450@2x); headless has no native zoom-factor switch; standard reflow-equivalent emulation
measurementSources.fulfillment: every browser request to the API origin is fulfilled by the driver from the direct loopback GET (127.0.0.1:8003), no credential/cookie forwarding, ACAO injected by the driver; PG-EV-04: every fulfilled response byte-compared (sha256) against a second direct loopback GET before serving; a mismatch is classified: clock-only ONLY when both bodies parse as JSON and every differing leaf is an ISO-date-parseable string under the allowlisted field name generated_at (proven in vivo on /v1/analytics/summary, which embeds a microsecond server clock; classifier contrast fixtures committed); any unexplained mismatch = run exits non-zero (STOP)
measurementSources.simulatedFailures: driver-scoped Fetch fulfillment of 500 for named paths only, to render in-tree role=alert branches; no request reaches the service and no service state changes
measurementSources.masking: post-measurement only: img/video/canvas blur(14px); household/asset display names and UUID-shaped runs replaced with U+25A0+U+200B (layout-safe) in text nodes and form values

notes.resolvePrivates: loopback GET /v1/households (+ /v1/assets) for the asset-detail route path
